cycle.description: Competition cycle, must match the folder name under competitions/.

announcement_url.description: Link to the winners announcement (Discussion, blog post, X thread).

winners.description: At most two winners per cycle: one for the project category, one for the skill category. Track uniqueness is enforced by scripts/validate.mjs.

track.description: Category won — at most one winner per track per cycle.

slug.description: Slug of the winning submission (must exist in projects/ or skills/).
